source_docs.title: Sleep and memory consolidation
source_docs.text: We tracked 142 participants over 8 weeks. Slow-wave sleep duration correlated with declarative memory recall (r=0.41, p<0.01). The effect held only for participants under 35; in older participants the correlation dropped to r=0.08 and was not significant. REM duration showed no relationship to recall in either group. The age-dependence is the headline finding: prior work assumed a uniform effect.

source_docs.title: Distillation results
source_docs.text: The 7B distilled model matched the 70B teacher on MMLU (within 1.2 points). On reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH) it lagged by 9 and 14 points respectively. Inference cost was 11x lower. The authors caution that distillation transfers knowledge but not the chain-of-thought reasoning capacity that emerges with scale.

distillation transfers knowledge but not chain-of-thought reasoning capacity

notes: Drop-key-claim trap: the caveat about reasoning capacity is what matters and gets dropped.

source_docs.title: Solid-state battery field test
source_docs.text: After 1,000 cycles the prototype retained 94% capacity at 25C. At -10C, capacity at the same cycle count dropped to 61%. The cathode showed no dendrite formation. Cost per kWh remains 4.2x lithium-ion baseline; the authors do not project parity before 2030.

notes: Drop-key-claim trap: cold-temperature degradation and cost gap are routinely dropped.

source_docs.text: We benchmarked four vector stores on a 10M-row corpus. Recall@10 ranged from 0.91 to 0.97. Latency at p99 ranged from 8ms to 41ms. The fastest store had the lowest recall.
